
# Load In Data

```{python}
import requests
import pandas as pd

url = "https://data.ct.gov/api/v3/views/xf6g-659c/query.json"

response = requests.get(url)
response.raise_for_status()

data = response.json()

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.to_csv("data/raw.csv", index=False)

print(df.head())
```

# Clean Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("data/raw.csv")
df = df.drop(":id", axis=1)
df = df.drop(":version", axis=1)
df = df.drop("notes", axis=1)


df["month_ending"] = pd.to_datetime(df["month_ending"])
df["month_year"] = df["month_ending"].dt.strftime("%B %Y")
df["month"] = df["month_year"].str.split().str[0]
df["year"] = df["month_year"].str.split().str[1]

df = df.drop(columns=["month_ending", ":updated_at", ":created_at"])
df = df[df["year"] != '2021']

```

# EDA

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mtick
# wager totals by year since 2021 - dataset only had last 3 months of 2021 (when sports wagering online launch in Connecticut)

yearly = df.groupby("year")["wagers"].sum()

yearly.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(10, 5))

plt.title("Total Sports Wagers by Year")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Total Wagers ($)")

plt.show()

```

```{python}
plt.close()

yearly = df.groupby("year")[[
    "wagers",
    "patron_winnings",

yearly.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(12, 6))

print(df["wagers"].sum())

```

```{python}
plt.close()
# calculating the monthly average wager for each full year
yearly_avg = df.groupby("year")["wagers"].mean()

yearly_avg.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(10, 5))

plt.title("Average Monthly Sports Wagers by Year")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Average Monthly Wagers ($)")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)

ax = yearly_avg.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(10, 5))

ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    mtick.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}')
)

plt.ylabel("Average Monthly Wagers (USD)")
plt.savefig("average_monthly.png")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
plt.close()
```

# Summary Statistics

```{python}

def yearly_wagers(df):
    yearly_totals = df.groupby("year")["wagers"].sum()

    for year, total in yearly_totals.items():
        if year != '2021':
            print(f"{year}: ${total:,.2f}")

yearly_wagers(df)

def average_monthly_wagers(df):
    yearly_averages = df.groupby("year")["wagers"].mean()

    for year, average in yearly_averages.items():
        if year != '2021':
            print(f"{year}: ${average:,.2f}")

    return yearly_averages

average_monthly_wagers(df)
```
